sentences.text: Specific role of accused Ali Khumeni and grounds to oppose the Bail Application.
1. The accused, Ali Khumeni, has been found to be involved in an intricate network operated by Chinese individuals in Cambodia.
This network trafficks Indian citizens under the guise of employment and subsequently forces them to work in fraudulent investment centers to deceive Indian nationals.
The accused Ali Khumeni is alleged to have served as an HR personnel in the fake investment center, working on a salary with additional commission for recruiting manpower from India.
2. On the instance of accused Ali Khumeni, whatsapp chats have been recovered from his mobile phone.

5. The passport of the accused, Ali Khumeni, has been seized in this case, confirming his travel to and from Cambodia and Dubai.

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the records.
9. The complainant in the FIR has given a categoric description of the facts relating to the present applicant.

It is stated in the FIR, that the present applicant got the complainant a job of Data Entry in Dubai and on his reaching Dubai, he was given 7 days training in a call centre run by a Chinese national and, thereafter, they were directed not to leave the campus or to talk any person outside from the campus without the permission of employer.

It is alleged that the complainant realised that the said call centre was running for cyber frauds targeting Indian Nationals by calling them from mobile numbers belonging to the United Kingdom and when they hesitated in doing so, they were thrashed and threatened.
It is alleged that in the meanwhile, while there were some raids on the said call centre, and they were threatened that in case they went out, they would be arrested in Dubai.

It is further stated that the complainant was then moved from Dubai to Bangkok, Thailand and,
thereafter, they were taken on company's vehicle for 6 hours near the Cambodian border, where their passports were taken, which were never returned to them.
As per the investigation, the present applicant was also present at the relevant time while the aforesaid complainant was in Dubai till he travelled to Cambodia.
It is further recorded that the complainants have received several threatening messages to harm their family members.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 10/07/2025 at 22:01:25 10.
The aforesaid complaint mentions the cases of the other victims, who were friends of the complainant and have been cited as the witnesses in the chargesheet.

On a pointed query from learned counsel for the applicant as to the status of the latter in the company recruiting the complainant and other victims, it is submitted that he was also a victim without giving any further details as to how and in which capacity he was associated with the said company to say that he was also a victim.
11. The matter is at the stage of committal before the learned Trial Court.
The main complainant and other victims are yet to be examined.

In the present case, it has prima facie come on record that the applicant was present all along when the complainant and the other victims were in Dubai as well as when they were taken to Cambodia and kept in confinement.
In these circumstances, this Court is of the considered opinion that the complainant and other victims be examined before the learned Trial Court before granting bail to the applicant.

12. In the aforesaid circumstances, the present application is dismissed at this stage and disposed of along with all pending application(s).
13.
Needless to state, nothing mentioned hereinabove is an opinion on the merits of the case and any observations made are only for the purpose of the present bail application.
